original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Under the twisted helper contract (H2-tw / H4-tw / K-tw of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1868) on the three repo-pinned R439 helper-star words (PR967, PR1062, PR1122), can arbitrary multi-donor, multi-writer corrections across all pre-first-read A writes W(a) to a star centre a (or two-leaf simultaneous omissions, or cross-centre chaining including the gain-0 moves) admit any omitted D helper-star restoration under fixed monotone frames or full-itinerary-preserving frames beyond the three single-writer absorptions (506^=374, 507^=355, 514^=367)?
scope_change_reason: The original semantic-D contract (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1311), single-writer twisted star absorption (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1868), and two-writer single-donor-per-writer absorption (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1913) are already covered. This refines the card to the explicit open next questions of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1868 (multi-gate splits of S and chaining the gain-0 moves) and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1913 (arbitrary multi-donor correction sets over full-itinerary-legal donors across pre-first-read writes).
bottleneck_link: Side result on the nonbinding bit supplier: resolves the complete pre-first-read F2-linear system for twisted helper-star absorption under fixed frames, showing that single-edge multi-donor and multi-writer splits cannot reduce scalar ADDs beyond -3 or improve the paid profile {1:1323, 2:1342, 3:79, 4:44, 5:102, 6:11, 7:19} (rank mass 5,129) within the checked single-centre donor systems, while the early monotone-climb-legal gain-0 moves split one H_2 climb into 2 H_1 (increasing child count by 1 at fixed rank mass). Multi-centre corrections consuming intermediate defect vectors of in-flight multi-write corrections are not covered. No new kappa is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop after solving the complete F2-linear donor systems (same_path and monotone_all), certifying dual hyperplanes for all unsolvable single-leaf and two-leaf targets, exhausting affine solution spaces for the five solvable edges, and checking cross-centre star-leaf-injection chaining on the three repo-pinned R439 star words.
evidence: Complete RREF and dual-hyperplane verification across all three repo-pinned R439 star words (pr967: 221 edges, 64 two-leaf centres, 280 dual witnesses; pr1062: 236 edges, 74 two-leaf centres, 305 dual witnesses; pr1122: 236 edges, 74 two-leaf centres, 305 dual witnesses). Exactly five single edges (506^=374, 507^=355, 514^=367 at min delta -1; 264^=536, 326^=530 at min delta 0) are solvable under both same_path and monotone_all; zero two-leaf pairs and zero cross-centre chained edges under the star-leaf-injection chaining pool are solvable. Complete 661-column forward/reverse literal COPY/ERASE replay, xcheck_p.py owner check, F/B precision bounds, 9 negative controls and 1 positive valid-dual check (valid and corrupted duals run through the same real target-parity/donor-orthogonality predicate over the real P_mono(a) pool), and an independent frozenset dual-witness oracle pass.
author: Aaron Wang

open_questions.question: Can absorbing a D helper-star restoration AFTER the centre's first A read succeed by simultaneously compensating the downstream reader gates under fixed frames?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Within the checked model (star-leaf defects e_b or e_{b1} xor e_{b2}, pre-first-read frame-legal donor toggles at one centre at a time, cross-centre injection limited to original star-leaf vectors), the five solvable edges here are the only solvable absorptions. Intermediate defect vectors from in-flight multi-write corrections at other centres are generally different vectors and are not covered, so this census does not prove that any further twisted-D absorption into A must cross at least one read of the twisted centre.
open_questions.first_step: For each star edge (a, b) whose first A read is a single-target z-write A[r_0] (c ^= a), propagate the defect to the two-register state (a, c) and test whether e_b lies in the joint frame-legal donor span before the next read of a or c.
open_questions.blocked_by: Crossing a read of a branches the defect into every reader register, requiring simultaneous multi-register restoration before any reader feeds a retained total at the scatter.
